description: This PHP file defines the 'Related' controller class in the OpenCart framework, responsible for handling the display of related products on a product page. It loads language resources, retrieves related product data, processes product descriptions, images, and prices, and renders the related products view.

classes.name: Related
classes.description: Controller class for displaying related products in the OpenCart catalog.

methods.name: index
methods.description: The main method that loads related products based on product ID, processes product data, and returns the rendered HTML view.
